events.title: Dig Deeper! King in the Mountain Joins Steam Next Fest with an Improved Demo
events.summary: Howdy, everyone!King in the Mountain is officially participating in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26! The new demo v0.90 is available on Steam, and I'm excited to welcome new players into the mountain!King in the Mountain is a relaxing incremental mining and resource management game about rebuilding a fallen dwarven kingdom, one expedition at a time.
